title: End-to-End RAG
readme_snippet:
# 📄 End-to-End RAG — Conversational Document Portal

A production-ready **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)** application that lets you upload PDF documents and chat with them through a clean web UI — no JavaScript, fully server-rendered.

Built with **FastAPI**, **LangChain LCEL**, **FAISS**, **HuggingFace Embeddings**, and **Groq LLM**.

---

## ✨ Features

- Upload multiple PDFs and index them instantly into a FAISS vector store
- Conversational Q&A powered by an LCEL chain with MMR retrieval
- Session-isolated ingestion — each upload gets its own FAISS index
- Idempotent document ingestion (no duplicate chunks)
- Structured JSON logging with per-session tracing
- Pure server-side rendered UI (Jinja2 + HTML forms, zero JavaScript)

---

## 🏗️ Architecture

```
Upload PDFs
    │
    ▼
ChatIngestor
    ├── save_upload_files()       # hash-named temp files
    ├── load_documents()          # PyMuPDF loader
    ├── RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
    └── FaissManager
            ├── load_or_create()  # FAISS vectorstore
            └── add_documents()   # idempotent upsert
                    │
                    ▼
            FAISS Index (session-scoped)
                    │
                    ▼
        ConversationalRAG (LCEL chain)
            ├── Contextualize question  →  Groq LLM
            ├── MMR Retriever           →  FAISS
            └── Context QA              →  Groq LLM
                    │
                    ▼
                Answer
```

---

## 🗂️ Project Structure

```
End_to_End_Rag/
├── app.py                          # FastAPI app (upload + chat endpoints)
├── src/
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── data_ingestion/
│   │   │   └── data_ingestion.py   # ChatIngestor, FaissManager
│   │   └── data_retrieval/
│   │       └── retrieval.py        # ConversationalRAG (LCEL)
│   ├── config/
│   │   └── config.yaml             # LLM, embedding, retriever config
│   ├── prompts/
│   │   └── prompt_library.py       # Contextualize + QA prompts
│   ├── model/
│   │   └── models.py               # Pydantic models
│   ├── utils/
│   │   ├── model_loader.py         # LLM + embeddings loader
│   │   ├── config_loader.py        # YAML config loader
│   │   ├── document_ops.py         # PDF document loader
│   │   └── file_io.py              # File save utilities
│   ├── exception/
│   │   └── custom_exception.py
│   └── logging/
│       └── custom_logger.py        # Structured JSON logger
├── templates/
│   └── index.html                  # Jinja2
